table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = item.name,
	itemalias= item.customicode,
	manfcode = Manufacturer.manfcode, 
	manfname = Manufacturer.Name,
	qty      = ISNULL(Sum(S.qty), 0), 
	discount = ISNULL(SUM(S.Discount), 0),
	salestax = ISNULL(SUM(S.salestax), 0),
	amount   = ISNULL(Sum(S.Amount), 0),
	supplier=
		(select a.name
		from 
			accounts a, itemsuppliers isp
		where 
			isp.icode = item.icode and 
			isp.suppcode = a.acccode and
			isp.priority in 
				(select p=min(ip.priority) 
				from itemsuppliers ip 
				where ip.icode = isp.icode))
FROM
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT 
		saledetail.icode,
		qty      = Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		discount = Round(Sum ( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc) * .01 + dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) , 2),
		salestax = Round(Sum((dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01), 2) + 
				Round(SUM((dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax), 2),
		amount   = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2)
	FROM 	 
		dbo.saleledger, dbo.saledetail
	WHERE
		dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
		dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		dbo.saledetail.icode IN (SELECT item.icode FROM Item WHERE Item.ManfCode IN (:ll_manfcode) and item.active = 1)
	GROUP BY 
		saledetail.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		sd.icode,
		qty      = Sum(sd.looseqty),
		discount = Round(Sum ( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) * (sd.discperc) * .01 + sd.looseqty * sd.itemflatdisc) , 2),
		salestax = Round(Sum((sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * sd.discperc * .01) * sd.gstperc * 0.01), 2) + 
				Round(SUM((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.unitsalestax), 2),
		amount   = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2)
	FROM 	 
		dbo.saleledger, dbo.saleinvdetail sd
	WHERE
		DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
		dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
		dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		sd.icode IN (SELECT item.icode FROM Item WHERE Item.ManfCode IN (:ll_manfcode) and item.active = 1)
	GROUP BY 
		sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		srdetail.icode,
		qty      = -Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty),
		discount = -Round(Sum ( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice) * (dbo.srdetail.discperc) * .01) , 2),
		salestax = - Round(Sum((dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01), 2) + 
				Round(SUM((dbo.srdetail.looseqty + dbo.srdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax), 2),
		amount   = -Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2)
	FROM 	 
		dbo.srledger, dbo.srdetail
	WHERE
		dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
		dbo.srdetail.icode IN (SELECT item.icode FROM Item WHERE Item.ManfCode IN (:ll_manfcode) and item.active = 1) AND
		IsNull(srledger.saleinvcode,-1) IN (SELECT saleinvcode =
		CASE :as_return when 'A' THEN
			IsNull(srledger.saleinvcode,-1) 
		ELSE
			(SELECT SaleLedger.SALEINVCODE FROM dbo.SaleLedger 
			WHERE dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
				SaleLedger.SALEINVCODE = srledger.saleinvcode)
		END
		)

GROUP BY 
	srdetail.icode) S ON (dbo.item.icode = S.icode), Manufacturer

WHERE
	dbo.item.manfcode in (:ll_manfcode) and
	dbo.item.active = 1 and
	dbo.item.manfcode = Manufacturer.manfcode 
GROUP BY 
	item.Icode,
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	Manufacturer.manfcode,
	Manufacturer.Name
ORDER BY
	Manufacturer.Name,
	item.name
